entries.title: Isaiah 48:1
segments: Out of the waters of Judah; from the family of Judah.  Compare

. 
 
  Swear by the name of the Lord; thus acknowledging him as your God.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:3
segments: Former things; formerly predicted and now fulfilled.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:6
segments:
Heard; the prediction. 
 
  See all this; see the whole accomplished. 
 
  Declare it; be my witnesses to its fulfilment.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:7
segments: Before the day when thou heardest them not; rather, "before to-day thou heardest them not."  Thy idol gave thee no prophetic intimation of them.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:8
segments:
From that time; from of old. 
 
  Thine ear was not opened; it was not revealed to thee. 
 
  For I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously; for the meaning, compare

entries.title: Isaiah 48:10
segments: Not with silver; or "for silver," the refining produced no good result.  Compare

entries.title: Isaiah 48:11
segments: God continues to carry forward his work of redemption in the hearts of his people, not from any goodness or faithfulness that he sees in them, but for the glory of his own name.  Lest his and their enemies should triumph in their destruction, he bears with their waywardness and folly, disciplines them with much longsuffering, and makes them at last eternal monuments of his almighty power and abounding grace.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:14
segments: Assemble yourselves; another challenge to the patrons of idolatry. Compare

. 
 
  These things; concerning the redemption of God's people. 
 
  Him; Cyrus, as the next verse shows. 
 
  He will do his pleasure; God, through Cyrus.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:16
segments:
In secret; my predictions have been open and unambiguous. 
 
  From the time that it was; from the time that these events began. 
 
  There am I; as the doer. 
 
  And now--hath sent me; the Messiah, who may be considered as speaking in God's name through the remainder of the chapter, and who speaks in the beginning of the following chapter.  To the Messiah, as God, the whole of the present verse may be referred.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:17
segments:
vv 17-19. 
 
Nothing is more plain than that the happiness and prosperity of God's people lie in whole-hearted obedience and devotion to him; yet nothing is so difficult for them to learn.  Sin and suffering make up a large part of their history.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:20
segments: Hath redeemed; in this and the following verse the deliverance of Israel is spoken of as already accomplished in God's purpose.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:21
segments: They thirsted not--gushed out; God provides for his people, as of old, when he delivered them from Egypt.  Allusions of this kind to the miraculous provision which God made for the wants of his people in the wilderness of Arabia, when on their way to the promised land, abound in this part of Isaiah, and are to be understood not literally but figuratively. .  Their spiritual application is given directly in

entries.title: Isaiah 48:22
segments: In all the glorious promises which God makes to those who love him, the wicked have no share.  Not peace but destruction is their portion.
